quote: We use named-entity recognition from Spacy (Honnibal and Montani, 2017), dependency parsing from Berkeley Neural Parser and semantic role labeling as our core methods to extract plausible answers and generate natural questions.
For question-answer generation, we use simple methods such as cloze-translation, template-based question-answer generation and question-answer semantic role labeling (QA-SRL).
We focus on unsupervised reading comprehension (RC) under evolving contexts and present the "Test-Time Learning" paradigm for this task.
outputs: synthetically generated question–answer pairs (questions and answer spans) used for test-time training
The paper generates question-answer pairs procedurally from a given context for reading comprehension, which involves natural language generation as part of the QA pair synthesis.

quote: We use the standard metrics for extractive QA - macro Exact Match, where the predicted answer span is directly matched with the groundtruth, and macro F1, which measures the overlap between the predicted and the ground-truth spans.
